# UNICON LEATHER — Global Leather Goods Manufacturer & Export Atelier

> UNICON LEATHER (Unicon Leather Goods Export Private Limited) is a premier Indian OEM/ODM private-label leather goods manufacturer and registered export house. Founded with master atelier facilities at Calcutta Leather Complex (CLC), Bantala, Kolkata, and corporate headquarters in Noida (Delhi NCR), India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Unicon Leather Goods Export Private Limited
- **Official Website:** https://www.uniconleather.com/
- **Business Type:** B2B Contract Manufacturer, OEM/ODM Atelier, Wholesale Exporter
- **Factory Facility:** Plot No. 42-45, Zone 3, Calcutta Leather Complex, Bantala, Kolkata, West Bengal 700135, India
- **Corporate HQ:** Office No. 11, 4th Floor, Indian Green Centre, 58, Bhangel, Sector - 106, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304, India
- **WhatsApp Desk:** +91-9873102341
- **Export Inquiries:** uniconexport@gmail.com / satish@myunicon.com

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Custom Leather Handbag Manufacturing:** Luxury satchels, structured shoulder bags, hobos, and evening clutches.
- **Leather Tote Bags Wholesale:** Feather-edge turned totes, architectural winged shoppers, and jacquard-leather hybrid carryalls.
- **Executive Laptop & Business Bags:** Double-gusset briefcases, slim leather folios, and commuter messenger bags.
- **Travel Luggage & Duffels:** Waxed pull-up leather weekender bags, framed doctor's bags, and rolling duffels.
- **Small Leather Goods (SLG):** RFID-shielded bifold and trifold wallets, cardholders, passport covers, money clips, and key pouches.
- **Leather Outerwear & Belts:** Tailored lambskin jackets, hand-burnished bridle leather belts, and custom hardware buckles.

## International Trade Corridors & Compliance
- **United States & North America (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-us):** California Proposition 65 SGS lab compliant (lead-free, cadmium-free, phthalate-safe), CPSIA verified, ASTM tested, direct DDP shipping to US distribution centers.
- **United Kingdom & Ireland (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-gb):** UK/EU REACH Annex XVII chemical safety compliant, SEDEX SMETA 4-Pillar ethical factory audit, CIF London Gateway / Southampton and DDP UK delivery.
- **Australia & New Zealand (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-au):** India-Australia ECTA 0% Preferential Import Duty with official Certificate of Origin (COO), Australian DAFF biosecurity import verified.
- **Germany & DACH Region (https://www.uniconleather.com/de):** DIN EN ISO norms, 100% REACH konform, LWG Gold zertifiziert, DDP Frankfurt / Hamburg.
- **France & Europe (https://www.uniconleather.com/fr):** Haute Maroquinerie craftsmanship, hand-painted and polished edge lacquer, REACH verified, DDP Paris / Le Havre.

## Sourcing Specifications & SLAs
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** 100 pieces per style (multi-colorway batching supported).
- **Prototype / Counter-Sample Turnaround:** 7 to 10 business days via DHL / FedEx Express.
- **Bulk Production Lead Time:** 30 to 45 business days upon sample approval.
- **Leather Tannages Sourced:** Full-grain bovine, Tuscan vegetable-tanned, Nappa calfskin, pebble grain, Nubuck, and crazy horse.
- **Tannery Auditing:** 100% hides sourced from Leather Working Group (LWG) Gold/Silver audited partner tanneries.
- **Quality Control Protocol:** 100% in-line inspection with final AQL 2.5 pre-shipment audit reports.
- **Supported Incoterms:** Ex-Works (EXW), FOB Kolkata / Chennai / Nhava Sheva, CIF, and DDP door-to-door.
